newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach shares leap to new high.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach shares leap to new high.

text.p: Shares in bus and train operator Stagecoach Holdings Plc rose to a record high on Monday amid continued investment demand, traders said.

The stock was up 31-1/2p at 725 by 1555 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 730p -- surpassing its previous peak of 696p set Friday and extending a rally since mid July, when it was trading just above 400p.
Stagecoach shares have powered ahead in recent months as the company expanded through a series of ambitious acquisitions.
Last month it received another boost as the company posted a better-than-expected 127 percent rise in first-half profits.
"They have been very good for the past month or so but there is no new story today," said a market-maker at one leading brokerage.
Trading volume in the stock was a robust 1.4 million shares.
